values.task_boundary: Preparation and coordination only; no product implementation belongs to #5497.
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: #5499, #5498, #5500, #5502, and #5501 retain disjoint issue ownership and execute in the canonical order
AC-2: WP-09 live merge and ancestry, not receipt presence, release #5499 preparation and execution
AC-3: #5500 and #5502 may execute in parallel after #5498 freezes observation and output contracts
AC-4: #5501 uses real tasks and disjoint writable shards; fixture-only evidence cannot satisfy the live proof
AC-5: #5497 owns no product path and cannot create tasks, mutate GitHub, merge, or close child issues
AC-6: Umbrella completion reports every child merge or explicit disposition and preserves receipts only as audit evidence
non_goals: a second lifecycle store or scheduler
